# taohq

> taohq is an independent software studio based in India. We make calm, durable apps for everyday life, build products for clients through our studio, and share some of our tools with the community as open source.

taohq (taohq.org) is operated by TheAlphaOnes, India.

## Products
- [Fold](https://taohq.org/products/fold): The journaling app for Gen Z. Photos, voice notes and quick thoughts. Free, iOS and Android, coming 2026. Waitlist: https://fold.taohq.org/#join
- [Bottles](https://taohq.org/products/bottles): Bookmarks and docs, filed properly. A quiet place for links, notes and files. Live at https://bottles.taohq.org
- [Bubbles.space](https://taohq.org/products/bubbles-space): A personal AI workspace OS where Bubbles, your assistant, lives. In development.
- [Bubbles.mail](https://taohq.org/products/bubbles-mail): An intelligent mail client that turns your inbox into a short report. In development.
- [web-have-sounds](https://taohq.org/products/web-have-sounds): Zero-dependency JavaScript library for UI sound effects generated with the Web Audio API. Open source: https://github.com/NormVg/web-have-sound
